statement: 对真实 Android APP 的可重复视觉证据，使用 source-owned deterministic fixture 驱动真实生产 Compose 树，在 emulator 中显式安装 app/test APK、运行 instrumentation、由 UiAutomation 捕获最终 display/compositor，再进行 PNG/方向/hash/provenance 校验并注册到 Surface ID。

scope.notes: Conservative Claim model of Experimental catalog record TEST.UIGS.ANDROID.DETERMINISTIC_COMPOSITOR_CAPTURE; scope is limited to its recorded provenance and original statement.

review.rationale: Modeled from a triage promotion candidate without changing Experimental maturity.
